MethodologyHow we calculate the value score

The "Value" column isn't a star rating. It's a deterministic score from 4 weighted criteria. Same input, same output.

01

Price floor

Lower entry price = higher base score. Free tiers get bonus weight if functionally usable.

02

Feature density

Voice + images + memory + unlimited messages = max feature points. Single-purpose apps score lower here.

03

Friction cost

Refund policy, billing transparency, ability to cancel easily. Hidden upsells lose points.

04

Free trial honesty

Functional free tier scores higher than a credit-card-required "trial" that hard-converts.

FAQThe pricing questions everyone asks

Which AI girlfriend app is completely free?
Janitor AI is genuinely free with no paywall. CrushOn.AI, Character.AI, PepHop AI and Replika all offer free tiers that are actually usable daily, but premium features (unlimited messages, advanced models, NSFW unlock on some) require a subscription. None of the visually advanced apps (image generation, voice) are 100% free.
What's the cheapest paid AI girlfriend app in 2026?
Anima AI at $5.83/month (billed annually $69.99/year) is technically the cheapest, but Candy.AI at $5.99/month gives you significantly more for the same price — voice, image generation, longer memory. For monthly billing without commitment, Candy.AI is the best entry point.
How much does Candy.AI really cost per month?
Candy.AI starts at $5.99/month if you pay monthly. The annual plan brings it down to about $4.99/month effective. The free tier exists but is heavily restricted — you'll hit the paywall within 10-15 messages. Plan to subscribe if you want serious usage.
Why is CrushOn.AI more expensive than Candy.AI?
CrushOn.AI charges $7.99/month vs Candy.AI's $5.99 because it gives unlimited messages and access to top-tier LLM models for roleplay. CrushOn's value proposition is volume + creative freedom; Candy's is polish + multimedia (voice, images). They're priced for different use cases.
Are these AI girlfriend prices in USD or local currency?
All prices on this site are in USD ($) as displayed by the apps themselves. Most apps bill in USD regardless of your location, then convert at checkout. Expect a 5-15% spread for non-USD currencies depending on your bank's FX rate. EU users typically pay 0.92x the dollar price after conversion.
Do AI girlfriend apps offer refunds?
Most apps offer a 7-day money-back guarantee on the first subscription (Candy.AI, CrushOn.AI). Replika offers prorated refunds within 30 days. Janitor AI is free so the question doesn't apply. Always check the specific terms at checkout — refund policies change.
